Name: Owljoy's Hats
Author: OwlandJoy
Description:
Hi! I made these custom hats to add some extra style to your farmer. They’re designed to fit perfectly with the game’s look for any occasion. I hope you enjoy them as much as I do!
[u]
[b]Installation instructions [/b][/u]
Simply download the file, unzip it, and drop the folder into your Stardew Valley "Mods" folder.
[u]
[b]Main features[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Adds a collection of new, custom-designed hats to your game.[/*]
